newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A symposium on Arab water security ends in Riyadh, warns consumers against excessive water use.

- The generating capacity of electricity companies in Saudi Arabia increased 16 times during the past two decades to 18,780 megawatts in 1996 from 1,173 megawatts in 1975, industry and electricity ministry says.
- Saudi firm al-Matbouli Group and South Korea's Samsung plan to establish a new 112.5 million riyal refrigerator factory in the kingdom.
- Riyadh chamber of commerce and industry to coordinate with five star hotels to ensure more jobs for Saudis in the hotel industry.
- Riyadh deputy governor opens 27 million riyal recreation projects in Riyadh.
- Islamic Development Bank finances three projects in Libya at a cost of $62 million.
- A group of investors bought a land in the eastern province at a cost of 130 million riyals on Wednesday in the biggest such transaction so far this year.
